name: Kite
summary: Shopify discount toolkit (by Skai Lama) built on native Shopify Functions: free gift with purchase, buy X get Y, tiered and volume discounts, progress bars and bulk codes.
best_for: shopify stores that want the discount mechanics themselves: gift with purchase, buy X get Y, tiered and volume pricing, with progress bars pushing the cart toward the next reward: built on native Shopify Functions rather than theme edits
skip_if: your promotions are simple enough for Shopify's own discount engine, or you are on Advanced or Plus and unwilling to start at $49, and if all you need is a pile of unique codes, a code generator does that for a third of the price
honest_knock: 'Free to install' is doing a lot of work on this listing. The free plan covers the first 50 discount orders a month, and the same panel says $29 a month is billed once you pass them, so it is a threshold with an invoice behind it, not a free tier you can settle on. A store running one decent promotion will cross 50 discounted orders in days and be on Starter money without choosing to upgrade. The second catch is written on the plans themselves: Free and Starter are both labelled 'Not for Shopify Advanced and Plus', so if you are on either of those Shopify plans your real entry price is the $49 Growth tier, not the $29 the listing leads with. And the feature most likely to sell the app to a large merchant, free gifts added at checkout, is marked Plus only and sits in the $99 Pro tier, which means the Plus stores it is built for pay $1,188 a year to reach it.

pricing.notes: (prices read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/kite-free-gift and in our own test the same day; first read 2026-09-06, unchanged since) Four plans, billed in USD every 30 days. The Free plan is free to install and covers the first 50 discount orders each month; the listing states that $29 a month is billed only if you go over 50 orders. Starter is $29 a month, or $299 a year at a stated 14% saving, and adds unlimited discount orders, combined offers, progress bars and up to 10K bulk codes. Growth is $49 a month, or $499 a year at 15%, and raises bulk codes to 100K with multiple rules per offer and campaign links. Pro is $99 a month, or $999 a year at 16%, and adds custom discount functions, checkout gifts (Plus only) and segment targeting. The three paid tiers carry a 7-day free trial. Free and Starter both say 'Not for Shopify Advanced and Plus'. A temporary offer seen only inside the app in our own test on 17 November 2026, not on the listing: Pro at $50 a month instead of $99, under “SPECIAL OFFER” and “Lock in this price forever”, with 14 days left; treat it as a dated promotion, the listing price of Pro is $99.

free_plan_evidence: The Free plan is free to install and covers the first 50 discount orders each month; the listing states that $29 a month is billed only if you go over 50 orders.

compare_with.name: Stackable
compare_with.why: Both sit on Shopify's native discount plumbing, and the split is between combining discounts and creating them. Stackable is about redemption: several discounts (order, collection, shipping) under a single code, plus a progress type, from $19.99 a month with no free plan. Kite is about the offers themselves: free gifts, BOGO, tiered and volume pricing, bulk codes and storefront widgets, opening at a metered free tier that turns into $29 past 50 discount orders. So if your promotions already exist and customers keep having to pick which code to use, that is Stackable's problem. If the promotion is the thing you cannot build (a gift that appears at a cart threshold, a tier that rewards the bigger basket) Kite is the one with those mechanics, and it has the far longer record: 1,161 reviews against Stackable's 54.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Kite on a Shopify development store: the install, which opened the app at once without a plan choice, the Free plan with 50 orders a month and no card, a free gift for carts of $100 and more built by the Kite AI from one example and saved in test mode (Changes Saved) in about 8 clicks and about 8 minutes, the plan page, the Shopify approval screen for Starter (a 7-day trial; it said there would be no test charge but also asked for a payment method; nothing approved) and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. The gift was not seen in a cart or in a preview, because the app embed was off. Nothing was paid. Install: the install form for the app (listing apps.shopify.com/kite-free-gift, Kite: Discount & Free Gift, English) was started at about 20:43 in our own tab and led to the Shopify screen Install app in the same tab. The screen warned that the app does not support market-driven shipping and said the app needs access to View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data. Install was clicked at about 20:44 and the app opened at once, with no plan choice and no payment screen. The welcome screen said Ready to convert more carts into customers? with a Get Started button. No terms tick box, no separate vendor account and no popup was seen. After that the start screen said Create your first promotion and that Kite AI builds the offer from a description in under 2 mins, with Theme app extension: Inactive and a button Enable App (not touched). Core action, a free gift from a cart total of $100: the example Free gift when they spend $100+ was picked. Kite AI answered that it would set up a free gift for carts that reach $100 once a gift was chosen and asked Which products are the free gift?; Demo Mug was chosen. The result at about 20:50 was the offer Free gift on orders over $100 with the rule Cart subtotal is at least US$ 100,00 and the gift Demo Mug x1, applied Automatically in the cart, with the visibility Test mode: hidden from shoppers, preview via campaign link, and the note Nothing is saved until you click Save in the editor. Open in editor and Save (at about 20:52) gave the toast Changes Saved on the page Free Gift With Purchase, with a switch Test mode and Live and the notice App not active on your store yet. Your offer is in test mode, not visible to customers. It took about 8 clicks and about 8 minutes from the install click, much of it waiting 5 to 10 seconds for each answer of the AI. The offer was saved in test mode, but it was NOT seen in a cart or in a preview: the app embed in the theme was off (Enable App was not clicked), no theme change was made and the Live switch was not used, so whether the gift is really added at a cart of $100 was NOT tested. Plans in the app (Pricing page): a message that on a Basic App Development plan the app can be tested for free and that nothing is billed for test stores; a bar SPECIAL OFFER Get Pro at $50/month instead of $99, Lock in this price forever, 14 days left; Free $0 a month with 50 orders per month, Analytics & scheduling and Free Gift, BOGO, Tiered & Shipping discounts, with the button Start for free and the text No credit card required; Starter $29 a month (For growing stores), Growth $49 a month (For scaling brands) and Pro with $99 crossed out and $50 a month, each with Start 7-day free trial and No commitment, cancel anytime. A Monthly and Yearly switch said Save up to 16% (the yearly prices were not looked at). Checkout: Start 7-day free trial on Starter opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription: a yellow bar You will not be billed for this test charge., the plan Monthly-Shopify-Aug26-STARTER-BASIC, $29,00 USD every 30 days, You have a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov., Subtotal $29,00 plus any applicable taxes, Total $29,00 Due 24 Nov, and also a row Add payment method (so no payment method was stored). The Free plan was not started. Because a payment method was asked and no card may be entered, the charge was not approved; Cancel was clicked and the app showed Charge declined. Cancelling: no subscription ran. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app (Open app, View details, Get support, Uninstall) and Uninstall: the dialog Uninstall Kite: Discount & Free Gift? says that you can no longer use the app, that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; a reason had to be chosen (Testing multiple apps) before the uninstall. Differences from the review: the review gives Pro as $99 a month, while the app shows $99 crossed out and $50 a month with 14 days left to lock in the price, which looks like a time-limited offer (the regular price after the offer was not seen, so this is only noted); the other prices agree (Starter $29, Growth $49, and 50 orders on Free). The price fields are not changed here. Not tested: the gift in a cart or in a preview (app embed off), the Live switch, the paid plans, the yearly prices, BOGO and tiered offers, Bulk discount codes, Kite MCP, Bundle Intelligence and the help chat. Clean up: the app was uninstalled at about 20:58 through Settings, Apps and disappeared from the list; the saved offer went with it. No theme change was made, no test product was made and no card was entered. Our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Much of the time went on waiting for the answers of the AI (5 to 10 seconds a step), the saved offer is only in test mode and the app embed is off by default, so the gift does not reach a cart until the app is enabled in the theme; and the approval screen said there would be no test charge but still asked for a payment method.

sessions.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Kite on a Shopify development store: the install, which opened the app at once without a plan choice, the Free plan with 50 orders a month and no card, a free gift for carts of $100 and more built by the Kite AI from one example and saved in test mode (Changes Saved) in about 8 clicks and about 8 minutes, the plan page, the Shopify approval screen for Starter (a 7-day trial; it said there would be no test charge but also asked for a payment method; nothing approved) and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. The gift was not seen in a cart or in a preview, because the app embed was off. Nothing was paid. Install: the install form for the app (listing apps.shopify.com/kite-free-gift, Kite: Discount & Free Gift, English) was started at about 20:43 in our own tab and led to the Shopify screen Install app in the same tab. The screen warned that the app does not support market-driven shipping and said the app needs access to View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data. Install was clicked at about 20:44 and the app opened at once, with no plan choice and no payment screen. The welcome screen said Ready to convert more carts into customers? with a Get Started button. No terms tick box, no separate vendor account and no popup was seen. After that the start screen said Create your first promotion and that Kite AI builds the offer from a description in under 2 mins, with Theme app extension: Inactive and a button Enable App (not touched). Core action, a free gift from a cart total of $100: the example Free gift when they spend $100+ was picked. Kite AI answered that it would set up a free gift for carts that reach $100 once a gift was chosen and asked Which products are the free gift?; Demo Mug was chosen. The result at about 20:50 was the offer Free gift on orders over $100 with the rule Cart subtotal is at least US$ 100,00 and the gift Demo Mug x1, applied Automatically in the cart, with the visibility Test mode: hidden from shoppers, preview via campaign link, and the note Nothing is saved until you click Save in the editor. Open in editor and Save (at about 20:52) gave the toast Changes Saved on the page Free Gift With Purchase, with a switch Test mode and Live and the notice App not active on your store yet. Your offer is in test mode, not visible to customers. It took about 8 clicks and about 8 minutes from the install click, much of it waiting 5 to 10 seconds for each answer of the AI. The offer was saved in test mode, but it was NOT seen in a cart or in a preview: the app embed in the theme was off (Enable App was not clicked), no theme change was made and the Live switch was not used, so whether the gift is really added at a cart of $100 was NOT tested. Plans in the app (Pricing page): a message that on a Basic App Development plan the app can be tested for free and that nothing is billed for test stores; a bar SPECIAL OFFER Get Pro at $50/month instead of $99, Lock in this price forever, 14 days left; Free $0 a month with 50 orders per month, Analytics & scheduling and Free Gift, BOGO, Tiered & Shipping discounts, with the button Start for free and the text No credit card required; Starter $29 a month (For growing stores), Growth $49 a month (For scaling brands) and Pro with $99 crossed out and $50 a month, each with Start 7-day free trial and No commitment, cancel anytime. A Monthly and Yearly switch said Save up to 16% (the yearly prices were not looked at). Checkout: Start 7-day free trial on Starter opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription: a yellow bar You will not be billed for this test charge., the plan Monthly-Shopify-Aug26-STARTER-BASIC, $29,00 USD every 30 days, You have a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov., Subtotal $29,00 plus any applicable taxes, Total $29,00 Due 24 Nov, and also a row Add payment method (so no payment method was stored). The Free plan was not started. Because a payment method was asked and no card may be entered, the charge was not approved; Cancel was clicked and the app showed Charge declined. Cancelling: no subscription ran. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app (Open app, View details, Get support, Uninstall) and Uninstall: the dialog Uninstall Kite: Discount & Free Gift? says that you can no longer use the app, that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; a reason had to be chosen (Testing multiple apps) before the uninstall. Differences from the review: the review gives Pro as $99 a month, while the app shows $99 crossed out and $50 a month with 14 days left to lock in the price, which looks like a time-limited offer (the regular price after the offer was not seen, so this is only noted); the other prices agree (Starter $29, Growth $49, and 50 orders on Free). The price fields are not changed here. Not tested: the gift in a cart or in a preview (app embed off), the Live switch, the paid plans, the yearly prices, BOGO and tiered offers, Bulk discount codes, Kite MCP, Bundle Intelligence and the help chat. Clean up: the app was uninstalled at about 20:58 through Settings, Apps and disappeared from the list; the saved offer went with it. No theme change was made, no test product was made and no card was entered. Our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
findings: Text we checked: "50 orders per month". What we saw: The Free card in the app says $0 a month with 50 orders per month, Analytics & scheduling and Free Gift, BOGO, Tiered & Shipping discounts, with the button Start for free and the text No credit card required. The Free plan was not started.

Text we checked: "Starter $29/month". What we saw: The plan card shows Starter at $29 a month (For growing stores) with a 7-day free trial and the Shopify approval screen showed $29,00 USD every 30 days. The yearly prices were not opened.
Text we checked: "Growth $49/month". What we saw: The plan card shows Growth at $49 a month (For scaling brands) with the button Start 7-day free trial. Its approval screen was not opened.

Text we checked: "Free gift on orders over $100". What we saw: Kite AI built the offer Free gift on orders over $100 (Cart subtotal is at least US$ 100,00 gives a Free gift, Demo Mug x1, Automatically in the cart) from one example and one product answer, and Save gave the toast Changes Saved in test mode. About 8 clicks and about 8 minutes, with much waiting for the AI.
not_tested: Original store creation and identity check, which we did ourselves.
The gift in a cart or in a preview and the Live switch (app embed off, no theme change made).
The paid plans, the yearly prices and the Free plan start.
BOGO and tiered offers, Bulk discount codes, Kite MCP, Bundle Intelligence and the help chat.
Approving any plan, so the admin of a paid plan was not seen.
Export and reimport.
